documentedChanges.note: Deliberate edits to the original west world made after d39d75a, each one asked for by the owner. 'sha256' above stays pinned to the pre-Aegean world and is what proves the Aegean work never touched the valley; 'sha256After' is what the west world is supposed to look like today. Only the fields listed in 'changes' may differ between the two - regions, spawns and chests are still compared against the frozen hashes, so a change that moves an enemy or a chest in the old world still fails. Re-record with scripts/record-aegean-legacy-baseline.mjs and add an entry here.
